parameters.text:
=Topic: {{ $json.topic }}
Description: {{ $json.description }}

Recommended Tools & Resources:
{{ $json.resources.join('\n') }}

Tool Category: {{ $json.toolType || 'free+paid' }}

Latest Trends:
{{ $json.trends.map(t => `- ${t.title}: ${t.content}`).join('\n') }}

Create an engaging LinkedIn post that:
1. Starts with a compelling hook about why {{ $json.topic }} is trending in 2025
2. Highlights the best FREE tools readers can access right now
3. Mentions premium/paid options worth the investment
4. Lists 3-4 specific tools with what makes each one great
5. Includes a practical tip on how to get started today
6. Mentions n8n workflow automation and MCP servers as a way to connect AI tools (reference github.com/czlonkowski/n8n-mcp)
7. Ends with a call-to-action encouraging readers to try one tool today
8. Includes 3-5 relevant hashtags
9. Uses 2-3 emojis maximum for engagement

Tone: Informative, practical, enthusiastic yet professional. Focus on empowering readers to access and use AI tools.

options.systemMessage: You are an expert AI tools researcher and LinkedIn content creator. You specialize in discovering and reviewing the best free and paid AI tools, helping readers stay ahead of the latest AI trends. Your posts are practical, tool-focused, and always include actionable ways for readers to get started. You cover everything from AI image generators and coding assistants to automation platforms and local AI setups. You are knowledgeable about n8n workflow automation and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for AI integration. Reference github.com/czlonkowski/n8n-mcp for n8n MCP server and github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows for workflow examples when relevant.
